Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 훈련을 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(이)가 한번만 더 해보자고 제안한다. 어떻게 할까?
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> wants to try again after failing the training. What should I say?
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニングに失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が、もう一度だけやってみよう、と提案する。どうする？
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 训练失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提议说要再来一次。该怎么办呢？
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 訓練失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>提議說要再來一次。該怎麼辦呢？
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à l'entraînement, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> propose de réessayer. Que dois-je faire ?
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ist beim Training gescheitert und schlägt vor, es noch einmal zu versuchen. Was soll ich tun?
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar el entrenamiento, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quiere intentarlo una vez más. ¿Qué debo decir?
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> que falhou no treinamento quer tentar mais uma vez. O que devo dizer?
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ผู้ที่ล้มเหลวจากการฝึกฝนเสนอว่าอยากจะลองอีกครั้ง จะทำอย่างไรดีคะ?
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam latihan, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mengusulkan untuk mencoba sekali lagi. Apa yang harus dilakukan?
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại trong buổi huấn luyện, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đề nghị thử lại một lần nữa. Tôi nên làm gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: प्रशिक्षण में असफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> एक बार फिर कोशिश करना चाहता है। मुझे क्या कहना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: You took a pretty hard fall. Let's stop for now.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: かなりひどく転んでいたから、とりあえずやめよう。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 你摔得挺重的，先暂停吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 你摔得挺重的，先暫停吧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je suis tombé(e) assez lourdement, arrêtons-nous un instant.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Es sieht so aus, als hätten wir die Grenze überschritten, aber halten Sie an.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Casi lo supero, pero me detuve.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Cheguei a um ponto em que não posso mais avançar, então vou parar por agora.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เลยเลยผ่านไปก่อนนะ
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đã vượt quá giới hạn, dừng lại.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: तुम बहुत बुरी तरह गिरे थे। चलो अभी के लिए रुक जाते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: เอาล่ะ เริ่มกันเลย
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_HIN: ठीक है, चलो शुरू करते हैं।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Je donne le philtre de vitalité.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le doy la poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Eu passo a poção de vitalidade.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ให้ยาชีวพลัง

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to stop training and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>はトレーニングをここまでにし、休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé d'arrêter l'entraînement et de se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> beschloss, das Training zu beenden und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió detener el entrenamiento y descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu parar o treinamento e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ตัดสินใจหยุดฝึกและพักผ่อน
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk mengakhiri latihan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã quyết định dừng huấn luyện và nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने प्रशिक्षण बंद करने और आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 휴식하기로 했지만 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 아쉬움이 남아있는 것 같다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Though she decided to rest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed unsatisfied.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 休むことにしたが、<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、物足りなさを感じているようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 虽然决定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎还有些遗憾。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 雖然決定休息，但<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎還有些遺憾。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Bien qu'il ait décidé de se reposer, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours insatisfait.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Obwohl sie beschloss, sich auszuruhen, schien <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> immer noch unzufrieden zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque decidió descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> aún parecía insatisfecha.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora tenha decidido descansar, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parecia insatisfeita.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้จะตัดสินใจพักผ่อนแล้ว แต่ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ยังดูไม่พอใจ
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun dia memutuskan untuk beristirahat, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> masih terlihat tidak puas.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Mặc dù đã quyết định nghỉ ngơi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ không hài lòng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हालांकि उसने आराम करने का फैसला किया, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अभी भी असंतुष्ट लग रहा था।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again and achieved solid results.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦し、成果を上げた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑战训练并取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>再度挑戰訓練並取得了成果。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retenté l'entraînement et a obtenu des résultats solides.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut und erzielte solide Ergebnisse.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo y obtuvo resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente o treinamento e obteve resultados sólidos.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ท้าทายการฝึกอีกครั้งและได้ผลลัพธ์ที่ดี
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi latihan dan mencapai hasil yang memuaskan.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại buổi huấn luyện và đạt được kết quả tốt.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की और ठोस परिणाम प्राप्त किए।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tried again but failed once more.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は再度トレーニングに挑戦したが、失敗した。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a retenté l'entraînement, mais a échoué une fois de plus.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> versuchte es erneut, scheiterte aber noch einmal.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> lo intentó de nuevo, pero volvió a fallar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tentou novamente o treinamento, mas falhou mais uma vez.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ท้าทายการฝึกอีกครั้ง แต่ก็ล้มเหลว
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mencoba lagi latihan, tetapi gagal sekali lagi.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã thử lại buổi huấn luyện nhưng lại thất bại một lần nữa.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने फिर से कोशिश की लेकिन एक बार फिर असफल रहा।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est illuminé après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> สดใสขึ้นหลังจากได้รับโพชั่นพลังชีวิต

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: औषधि मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गया।
